items.information:

Only competitors from Ohio are eligible for the title of Ohio Champion. See [Ohio Champion Title Eligibility tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OhioChampionship2025#59661-ohio-champion-title-eligibility) for details.

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).

If you are not staff or not competing in multiblind, PLEASE wait until multiblind has ended to arrive and enter the venue.

This competition is organized by Cube New England, a non-profit organization dedicated to the growth of speedcubing in New England.
